requirements.quote: Inside that directory, there must be exactly TWO text files, with names and **precise content/format** as follows.
Contains only the `run_id` values (nothing else) of the rows in `pipeline_runs.csv` where `platform == "android"`, `branch == "main"` and `result == "SUCCESS"`.

check.cmd: test -f /home/user/projects/mobile-ci/reports/android_main_pass.txt && tr -d '\r' < /home/user/projects/mobile-ci/pipeline_runs.csv | awk -F';' '$2=="android" && $3=="main" && $4=="SUCCESS" {print $1}' | LC_ALL=C sort | cmp -s - /home/user/projects/mobile-ci/reports/android_main_pass.txt

requirements.quote: Contains only the `run_id` values (nothing else) of the rows in `pipeline_runs.csv` where `platform == "ios"`, `branch == "develop"` and `result == "FAILURE"`.

check.cmd: test -f /home/user/projects/mobile-ci/reports/ios_dev_fail.txt && tr -d '\r' < /home/user/projects/mobile-ci/pipeline_runs.csv | awk -F';' '$2=="ios" && $3=="develop" && $4=="FAILURE" {print $1}' | LC_ALL=C sort | cmp -s - /home/user/projects/mobile-ci/reports/ios_dev_fail.txt

requirements.quote: Sort the selected `run_id` values in ascending (lexicographic) order before writing.
Every line, including the last line, MUST end with a single UNIX newline character “\n”.

check.cmd: for f in /home/user/projects/mobile-ci/reports/android_main_pass.txt /home/user/projects/mobile-ci/reports/ios_dev_fail.txt; do test -z "$(tail -c1 $f)" || exit 1; grep -q "$(printf '\r')" $f && exit 1; done; exit 0

requirements.quote: No extra blank lines or trailing spaces are allowed.
delete the `/srv/ember` directory and everything inside it.
